page.name: Lighting
page.label: "Connect a model to Source and a 360 degree equirectangular image to Environment. Illuminates the surface from the image, replacing default lighting."
"Adds diffuse environment illumination. Chain Three-Point Light for direct specular highlights and Environment Reflections for reflected imagery. Shadows and occlusion are not included."

page.name: Orientation
page.label: "World axes: +Y is up; +Z is the panorama center. Rotation applies X, then Y, then Z. Limit: 4 megapixels; resize or crop larger images before connecting."
